sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety candidates inside the current-week window; BPO, GFlowRL, and SAFETY SENTRY were detected as already published, then ToolAlignBench was selected from the same unified table.
The arXiv abstract page, full PDF text, project page, GitHub repository README, and Hugging Face dataset card were read for method, data, metrics, results, ablation, and reproducibility limits.
The article maps ToolAlignBench's dataset construction, tool taxonomy, runner and analysis assets, evaluation metrics, and permission-system implications.
The Markdown distinguishes deployment-instruction misalignment from moral wrongness, and calls out synthetic documents, scratchpad prompting, rule-based parsing, and model-version drift as limits.
The paper was positioned against ToolBench, AgentBench, ToolEmu, Agent-SafetyBench, OpenDeception, instruction hierarchy, safe-completions, and pluralistic alignment.
The Markdown uses TL;DR, tables, formula blocks, Mermaid, detail inventory, evidence tables, and bounded research conclusions; no evidence-bearing image needed localization.
